label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 138 ]

blocks.text: The mosquito is the insect most willing to duel with man. At one time or another, we have all stood on a bed in our pajamas with a slipper in our hand and our eyes fixed on the ceiling. Faced with man, the mosquito's strategy has evolved. It has learned to be quicker, more inconspicuous and livelier on the takeoff. Some bold mosquitos of the latest generation do not hesitate to hide under their victims' pillows. They have discovered the principle of Edgar Allan Poe's Stolen Letter : the best hiding place is the most obvious one, for we always think of looking farther away for something that is very near.

readingSentences.korean: 모기는 가장 기꺼이 인간과 겨루려 하는 곤충이다.

readingSentences.korean: 최근 세대의 일부 대단한 모기는 주저하지 않고 희생자의 베게밑에 숨는다. 그 모기들은 에드가 알랜 포우의 Stolen Letter의 원리를 발견했다.

readingSentences.english: They have discovered the principle of Edgar Allan Poe's Stolen Letter : the best hiding place is the most obvious one, for we always think of looking farther away for something that is very near.
readingSentences.korean: 가장 좋은 숨을 장소는 가장 잘보이는 곳이다. 왜냐하면 우리는 항상 매우 가가운 것을 멀리서 찾을 것에 대해 항상 생각한다.
